description: This PHP source file defines the SocialMediaAuthenticationService class, which serves as a service layer for managing social media (OpenID Connect) authentication within the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods for initiating authentication, handling user identity mapping, retrieving configuration details, and checking if social media authentication is enabled. The class uses multiple traits and depends on DAOs for data access, integrating with the overall authentication and user management modules.

classes.name: SocialMediaAuthenticationService
classes.description: A service class responsible for managing social media authentication workflows using OpenID Connect in the OrangeHRM system, including initiating authentication, associating user identities, and checking if social media login is enabled.

methods.name: getAuthProviderDao
methods.description: Returns the data access object for authentication providers, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: getUserDao
methods.description: Returns the data access object for user data, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: initiateAuthentication
methods.description: Creates and configures an OpenIDConnectClient instance to start the authentication process with a specific provider.

methods.name: getRedirectURL
methods.description: Generates the URL to redirect users to for OpenID Connect login.

methods.name: getScope
methods.description: Returns the scope string ('email') used in OpenID Connect authentication.

methods.name: getSystemUsers
methods.description: Searches for system users matching the provided username.

methods.name: getUserForAuthenticate
methods.description: Retrieves and validates a user based on the provided credentials for authentication purposes.

methods.name: setOIDCUserIdentity
methods.description: Associates a User with an OpenIdProvider by creating and saving an OpenIdUserIdentity record.

methods.name: handleOIDCAuthentication
methods.description: Completes the authentication process for a user by setting login credentials.

methods.name: isSocialMediaAuthEnable
methods.description: Checks whether social media (OpenID) authentication providers are enabled and available.
